/// file name -> (offset, len) of the FileDescriptorProto within `bytes`.\n    files: HashMap<String, (usize, usize)>,\n    /// fully-qualified symbol -> file name.\n    symbols: HashMap<String, String>,\n}\n\npub struct ActiveReflectionCatalog {\n    dir: PathBuf,\n    entries: HashMap<String, Entry>,\n}\n\nimpl ActiveReflectionCatalog {\n    /// Open (and create) a catalog directory, loading any existing blobs.\n    pub fn open(dir: impl Into<PathBuf>) -> io::Result<Self> {\n        let dir = dir.into();\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir)?;\n        let mut cat = Self {\n            dir: dir.clone(),\n            entries: HashMap::new(),\n        };\n        for e in std::fs::read_dir(&dir)? {\n            let path = e?.path();\n            if path.extension().and_then(|x| x.to_str()) == Some(\"blob\") {\n                if let Err(err) = cat.load_file(&path) {\n                    // A corrupt blob must not take the catalog down; it is\n                    // simply not advertised.\n                    eprintln!(\"op-blob: skipping {}: {err}\", path.display());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(cat)\n    }\n\n    /// Default runtime location on tmpfs (REQ-8.3: never Btrfs-backed I/O).\n    pub fn open_shm() -> io::Result<Self> {\n        Self::open(DEFAULT_SHM_DIR)\n    }\n\n    fn load_file(&mut self, path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {\n        let bytes = std::fs::read(path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n        let entry = index_entry(path.to_path_buf(), bytes)?;\n        self.entries.insert(entry.manifest.plugin_id.clone(), entry);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Whitepaper lifecycle steps 10–12: persist the sealed blob, drop stale\n    /// hash versions of the same plugin, rebuild the reflection index.\n    pub fn upsert_blob(&mut self, blob: &PluginObjectBlob) -> io::Result<PathBuf> {\n        let path = blob.write_to_dir(&self.dir)?;\n        // Remove superseded hash versions on disk.\n        let prefix = format!(\"{}.\", blob.manifest.plugin_id);\n        for e in std::fs::read_dir(&self.dir)? {\n            let p = e?.path();\n            if p != path {\n                if let Some(name) = p.file_name().and_then(|n| n.to_str()) {\n                    if name.starts_with(&prefix) && name.ends_with(\".blob\") {\n                        let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&p);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        let bytes = std::fs::read(&path)?;\n        let entry = index_entry(path.clone(), bytes)\n            .map_err(|e| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, e))?;\n        self.entries.insert(blob.manifest.plugin_id.clone(), entry);\n        Ok(path)\n    }\n\n    /// Inverse lifecycle: deactivate the plugin object, delete the artifact,\n    /// stop advertising its services.\n    pub fn remove_blob(&mut self, plugin_id: &str) -> io::Result<bool> {\n        match self.entries.remove(plugin_id) {\n            Some(entry) => {\n                if entry.path.exists() {\n                    std::fs::remove_file(&entry.path)?;\n                }\n                Ok(true)\n            }\n            None => Ok(false),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Reflection `ListServices`: only active blobs, sorted.\n    pub fn list_services(&self) -> Vec<String> {\n        let mut v: Vec<String> = self\n            .entries\n            .values()\n            .flat_map(|e| e.manifest.grpc.services.iter().cloned())\n            .collect();\n        v.sort();\n        v\n    }\n\n    pub fn active_plugins(&self) -> Vec<String> {\n        let mut v: Vec<String> = self.entries.keys().cloned().collect();\n        v.sort();\n        v\n    }\n\n    /// Reflection `file_by_filename`: borrowed `FileDescriptorProto` bytes.\n    pub fn file_by_filename(&self, filename: &str) -> Option<&[u8]> {\n        self.entries.values().find_map(|e| {\n            e.files\n                .get(filename)\n                .map(|(off, len)| &e.bytes[*off..*off + *len])\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Reflection `file_containing_symbol`.\n    pub fn symbol_by_name(&self, symbol: &str) -> Option<&[u8]> {\n        self.entries.values().find_map(|e| {\n            e.symbols\n                .get(symbol)\n                .and_then(|file| e.files.get(file))\n mut v: Vec<PathBuf> = self.entries.values().map(|e| e.path.clone()).collect();\n        v.sort();\n        v\n    }\n}\n\nfn index_entry(path: PathBuf, bytes: Vec<u8>) -> Result<Entry, String> {\n    let (manifest, files) = {\n        let blob = BlobRef::new(&bytes)?;\n        let manifest = blob.manifest()?;\n        let set = blob.descriptor_set();\n        let set_start = set.as_ptr() as usize {\n        for s in &m.symbols {\n            symbols.insert(s.clone(), m.grpc_file.clone());\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(Entry {\n        path,\n        bytes,\n        manifest,\n        files,\n {"timestamp":"2026-07-04T00:46:34.371Z","type":"event_msg","payload":{"type":"agent_message","message":"Yes. There are two relevant `ActiveReflectionCatalog`s:\n\n`op_blob::catalog::ActiveReflectionCatalog` contains persisted sealed blobs. Internally it stores entries with blob bytes, manifest, file index, and symbol index. Its API is `open_shm()`, `upsert_blob(&PluginObjectBlob)`, `remove_blob()`, `list_services()`, `manifest()`, and `blob_paths()`.\n\n`op-grpc-bridge::dynamic_reflection::ActiveReflectionCatalog` also contains blobs in memory: `blobs: BTreeMap<String, PluginObjectBlob>`.\n\nThe current compile break is because bridge code expects the old flat blob shape like `blob.plugin_id`, `blob.grpc`, `blob.schema_hash`, and `op_blob::BlobStore`. The actual blob shape is now `blob.manifest.plugin_id`, `blob.manifest.grpc`, `blob.manifest.schema_hash`, plus `blob.descriptor_set`; persistence should use `op_blob::ActiveReflectionCatalog::open_shm().upsert_blob(&blob)`, not `BlobStore`.","phase":"final_answer","memory_citation":null}}

Internally it stores entries with blob bytes, manifest, file index, and symbol index. Its API is `open_shm()`, `upsert_blob(&PluginObjectBlob)`, `remove_blob()`, `list_services()`, `manifest()`, and `blob_paths()`.\n\n`op-grpc-bridge::dynamic_reflection::ActiveReflectionCatalog` also contains blobs in memory: `blobs: BTreeMap<String, PluginObjectBlob>`.\n\nThe current compile break is because bridge code expects the old flat blob shape like `blob.plugin_id`, `blob.grpc`, `blob.schema_hash`, and `op_blob::BlobStore`. The actual blob shape is now `blob.manifest.plugin_id`, `blob.manifest.grpc`, `blob.manifest.schema_hash`, plus `blob.descriptor_set`; persistence should use `op_blob::ActiveReflectionCatalog::open_shm().upsert_blob(&blob)`, not `BlobStore`."}],"phase":"final_answer","internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough":{"turn_id":"019f2a97-3027-70a2-bb35-0183ebd2e289"}}}

Those\n//! built-ins are intentionally exposed through explicit compatibility helpers\n//! so runtime code can continue to resolve legacy schemas without turning this\n//! catalog back into a second schema authority.\n\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse simd_json::prelude::*;\nuse simd_json::{json, OwnedValue as Value};\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::fs;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n\n/// Default JSON Schema dialect (can be overridden per-schema)\npub const DEFAULT_SCHEMA_DIALECT: &str = \"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema\";\n\n/// Known dialect identifiers\npub mod dialects {\n    pub const DRAFT_07: &str = \"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#\";\n    pub const DRAFT_2019_09: &str = \"https://json-schema.org/draft/2019-09/schema\";\n    pub const DRAFT_2020_12: &str = \"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema\";\n}\n\n/// Path to the json-schema-spec repository relative to workspace root\nconst SCHEMA_SPEC_PATH: &str = \"json-schema-spec\";\n\n/// Schema field type\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"snake_case\")]\npub enum FieldType {\n    String,\n    Integer,\n    Float,\n    Boolean,\n    Array(Box<FieldType>),\n    Object(HashMap<String, FieldSchema>),\n    Enum(Vec<String>),\n    /// Discriminated union (tagged enum): the value must match exactly one of\n    /// the inner branch types. Distinct from\n    /// `Constraint::OneOf` (a value-membership constraint).\n    OneOf(Vec<FieldType>),\n    Any,\n}\n\n/// Schema for a single field\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]\npub struct FieldSchema {\n    /// Field type\n    pub field_type: FieldType,\n    /// Whether the field is required\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub required: bool,\n    /// Description of the field\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub description: String,\n    /// Default value if not provided\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub default: Option<Value>,\n    /// Example value for documentation\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub example: Option<Value>,\n    /// Validation constraints\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub constraints: Vec<Constraint>,\n    /// Unconditional readOnly - field cannot be modified\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub read_only: bool,\n    /// Conditional readOnly via propertyDependencies\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub read_only_when: Option<ReadOnlyCondition>,\n}\n\n/// Condition for conditional readOnly (via propertyDependencies)\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]\npub struct ReadOnlyCondition {\n    /// The property to check (e.g., \"status\", \"running\")\n    pub property: String,\n    /// The value that triggers readOnly (e.g., \"locked\", \"true\")\n    pub value: String,\n}\n\n/// Validation constraint\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]\n#[serde(tag = \"type\", rename_all = \"snake_case\")]\npub enum Constraint {\n    /// Minimum value (for numbers) or length (for strings/arrays)\n    Min { value: f64 },\n    /// Maximum value (for numbers) or length (for strings/arrays)\n    Max { value: f64 },\n    /// Regex pattern (for strings)\n    Pattern { regex: String },\n    /// Value must be one of these\n    OneOf { values: Vec<Value> },\n    /// Reference to another field that must exist\n    RequiresField { field: String },\n    /// Custom validation function name\n    Custom { validator: String },\n}\n\n/// Side-effect classification for a method declaration.\n///\n/// `Read` methods do not mutate plugin state; `Mutation` methods do.\n/// The serde representation is `snake_case` so serialized output is\n/// `\"read\"` or `\"mutation\"`.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]\n#[serde(rename_all = \"snake_case\")]\npub enum SideEffect {\n    Read,\n    Mutation,\n}\n\n/// Declares a single callable method on a plugin's capability surface.\n///\n/// Every `MethodDecl` is exposed as a D-Bus method (and gRPC route) by the\n/// bridge.  The `args` field is a JSON Schema object that the bridge uses to\n/// validate caller arguments before dispatch.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]\npub struct MethodDecl {\n    /// Method name as it appears on the D-Bus interface / gRPC route.\n    pub name: String,\n    /// JSON Schema describing the method's input arguments.\n    pub args: Value,\n    /// Optional JSON Schema describing the method's return value.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub returns: Option<Value>,\n    /// Whether the method reads or mutates state.\n    pub side_effect: SideEffect,\n    /// Whether repeated calls with the same args produce the same effect.\n    pub idempotent: bool,\n    /// If non-null, the caller's footprint must grant this capability.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub required_capability: Option<String>,\n    /// OSCAL subid for this method (e.g. `mut.network.wireguard.set-key@v1`).\n    pub subid: String,\n}\n\n/// Declares a signal emitted by a plugin.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct SignalDecl {\n    /// Signal name as it appears on the D-Bus interface.\n    pub name: String,\n    /// Optional JSON Schema describing the signal payload.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub payload: Option<Value>,\n    /// OSCAL subid for this signal (category must be `evt`).\n    pub subid: String,\n}\n\n/// Canonical plugin capability guarantees.\n///\n/// This is the **single** definition of `PluginCapabilities` in the workspace.\n/// The 4-field structure is the source of truth; Display-only;\n    /// does not affect D-Bus path or interface name.
